items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: I'll tell you someone that reminds me a lot of him now is Josiah Frazier.

ctx.x: Anything about his style of playing that you can say that is... Well, say compared to the drummers now. Of course, a lot of people think the drummers today are too noisy and jump all over the place, you know. Did he... Is he very active or was he a rather quiet drummer? Or what did you say?

Well, he was active, I think, for the period of time. I'll tell you someone that reminds me a lot of him now is Josiah Frazier. Oh, yeah. Yeah, it was more on that type. You see, just about the way Frazier plays, that was most of my father's style of playing. The way Frazier plays now.

Yeah, I was noticing Saeed the other week, he seems to hit the bass drum on one and three. One and three. That's right. That's the two beat. That's what they call the two beat. The one and three. And then his snares seem to more accent the two and four.
